validatedBehaviors: Per-model required fields, unknown nested options, exact record envelope and identity
Paired matrix/scheme/index, sensor steps/cursor, memory die/address/stack/banks, duration/time
Bounded simulation preflight before full model validation
Mount/default registration leaves invalid saved raw data untouched
Storage transaction commits active record before swapping live values
Failed/invalid import preserves active inputs and active storage
Recovery swap and storage failure handling
Generation guard rejects canceled timers and stale component writes
Import tickets reject reordered file reads and edits during import
Latest edits persist on debounce and page/unmount flush
Progress views, metrics, intervals, allocations and worked controls
The same UTF-8 byte limit applies to stored/exported JSON and uploaded files
scope: Controller/model tests and source-level React lifecycle review. Physical-device, browser rendering, assistive-technology, human-learner and specialist reviews are not established by these tests.
limitations: Cell/net highlight strings are bounded and resolved against the lazily fetched artifact by the realization component.
Fabrication section 0 or 1 is stored across stages; the component clamps it to the current stage sections.
LocalStorage atomicity applies to the active key. If both an active write and backup rollback fail, the prior backup can change, while the live workspace and active record remain unchanged.
